svg.title: After: PostgreSQL scaled out with Citus
svg.desc: The same architecture with PostgreSQL replaced by a Citus cluster. ThingsBoard writes attributes and latest values straight to four workers, each at normal load; the coordinator handles schema changes and cross-worker queries and stays off the write path.
svg.text: After: PostgreSQL scaled out with Citus
ThingsBoard sends each device's latest values straight to the worker that owns it, so the load splits four ways
telemetry history · every message appends a new row
schema changes, cross-worker queries · off the write path
